subject: general
question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

Helen Keller __was borne on__ 27 June 1880 in Tuscumbia.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The improved version of the underlined part of the sentence is:** "was born on"**
 
• The phrase **"was born on"** is the standard English phrase used to indicate the date of someone's birth.
 
• The verb** "to be born"** refers to the act of being given birth to.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: *'Helen Keller **was born on** 27 June 1880 in Tuscumbia.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Here's why the other options aren't correct:
 
 
• **"Was birth on"** is grammatically incorrect. The verb "birth" is not used in this way. We use "was born" to indicate someone's birth.
 
• **"Is borne in"** is incorrect for the same reasons as above. Also, the verb should be in the past tense ("was") to match the past time context, not the present tense ("is").
